summary: Retest of iteration-1 fixes. Regression suite test_predator_core.py: 25/25 passed. New suite test_iteration2_fixes.py: 9/12 passed. These fixes are verified: discount request and approve blocked when the total would drop below the amount paid; cancel of a Masuk job with a DP refund leaves gross_profit unchanged (refund_total +60k, net_cash +40k, cancel_kept +40k, return_refund +0); CMS navigation.cta_href rejects javascript: (also mixed case with leading space); image and logo fields reject javascript:, data: and vbscript:, and accept /layanan, #whatsapp, https:// and /api/media/file/; a claim on a removed line returns 404 and a claim on a kept line works; positional line updates hold under concurrency (5 admin edits running alongside 5 kasir adds, plus remove alongside add: all lines kept, totals correct); a NEW vehicle whose plate already exists (any case) returns 409 'Plat sudah terdaftar...', and choosing the existing vehicle by id works. Report fix 1 (COD write-off) is only partly correct: write_off and the formulas are consistent, but gross profit still moves. Frontend is all good: 'Belum ada tagihan' shows on a job with no lines and 'Lunas' is hidden; 'Tandai Selesai' is disabled until a package is added; a Selesai job shows 'Tidak ada diskon'; Cetak 80mm and A4 open /admin/cetak/job/{id}?size=80|a4; Kirim via WhatsApp opens a WhatsApp send URL in a new tab; the 3 nota buttons are <button> elements not inside <a>; the Reports page shows the 'Retur (refund + COD batal)' card and the definitions block. No page errors.

critical.issue: write_off = total - paid includes shipping_cost, but omzet_of() leaves shipping out of omzet. A fully returned, unpaid COD order with 20k shipping changes the report by: omzet +1,500,000, write_off +1,520,000, net_revenue -20,000, gross_profit -20,000. A returned COD order should leave profit unchanged, but it now subtracts the shipping cost from profit. Fix: write_off = max(total - shipping_cost - paid, 0) (the unpaid omzet part), or count only the omzet part of write_off in the report.

Write-off is counted twice when one COD order has two returns. Example: a COD order (total 1.5M) gets a partial return of 1 item, then a second return of another item. Each return records write_off = total - paid, so 3,000,000 is written off. Nothing stops further returns after ship_status='Kembali', and process_return does not check doc.written_off. Fix: write off only once (skip if doc.get('written_off')), or block returns when the order is already Kembali.

minor.issue: An admin line edit or removal can push the total below the amount already paid (example: paid 80k, price edited 100k -> 30k, so total 30k and paid 80k). This is the same overpayment risk that the discount fix closed, but it is not guarded here. Block it, or require recording a refund.
Regex ^(https?://|/|#|mailto:|tel:) also accepts protocol-relative '//evil.com' (and '/\evil.com'), which works as an open redirect or external link. Consider ^/(?![/\\]).
The check matches keys only by suffix. Plural or other keys (e.g. 'images', 'avatar', 'src', 'og_url' is covered, 'video') are not checked.

issues: Reports still uses native <input type='date'> (report-start/report-end) instead of the shadcn calendar/date picker.

The PageHead actions column stacks the two date inputs at full width above the buttons. The header becomes tall, and the title 'Laporan' sits vertically centred and pushed down. Put the inputs inline (flex-nowrap or a fixed width).
Export buttons are still nested as (button inside link), which is invalid HTML. This is the same pattern that was fixed for NotaActions.

action_items: Leave shipping_cost out of the COD write_off (write_off = max(total - shipping_cost - paid, 0)), so that a returned COD order leaves gross_profit unchanged.
Stop the COD write-off from being counted twice on multiple returns: check doc.written_off, or reject returns on orders already 'Kembali'.
Guard admin line edit/remove so the total cannot fall below paid (or force a refund record).
Optional: tighten SAFE_URL to reject '//' protocol-relative URLs; use the shadcn date picker on Reports and fix the header layout; un-nest the export <a><button>.

rca of the issue: COD write-off: omzet_of(order) = total - shipping_cost, but process_return sets write_off = total - paid, which includes shipping. net_revenue therefore subtracts more than was ever counted as revenue, by exactly shipping_cost. Repro: COD Jawa Timur order with shipping 20000; ship; return all items as layak with refund 0; the day's gross_profit falls by 20000. Double write-off: each process_return call on an unsettled COD order recalculates write_off = total - paid without checking orders.written_off. Repro: ship a COD order, then return item A and later item B; sum(returns.write_off) = 2 x total.
